name: seo-butler
description: Test harness for the seo-butler plugin's deterministic scripts. The plugin itself ships as markdown + dependency-free .mjs; this file exists only so `npm test` and CI have an entry point.
$testComment: No glob argument on purpose: --test only understands glob patterns from Node 22 on, and the scripts under test support Node 18+. Bare `node --test` uses the built-in recursive discovery, which finds tests/**/*.test.mjs on every supported version.
